plain_description.what: Engineering, no calls. Added a scheduler option that only sends a question to the judge when the two models gave different final answers. It needs no answer key, is off by default, and falls back cleanly when answers cannot be extracted. Checked with tests and a bit-identical replay with the option off.
plain_description.why: It turns the SCHEDULING finding into a usable feature that cuts judge spend on matches that carry no signal.
plain_description.information: It shows the cheaper scheduling can ship without changing past results. Result: done, shipped. 307 tests pass, the replay with the filter off is identical, and it reproduces the 16.9% figure from SCHEDULING. Later caveat: the filter lowers the reliability of the per-subject capability profile (0.72 to 0.56), so it does not suit that use.
